description: Returns a verse in its setting in one call: the verses before and after (2 each by default, 0-8), the verse itself, or up to 5, word by word, and its cross-references, quotations and parallels. Combines several lookups into one answer. Use when the user asks what surrounds a verse, with its neighbouring verses and connections.

edition.description: which text, e.g. septuagint, onkelos, pseudo-jonathan, jonathan, hebrew-nt, hebrew or greek

max_chars.description: optional: cap the answer at about this many characters (lists are shortened and marked truncated; use offset/nextOffset to get the rest)

name: get_context
title: A verse in its setting
